#{userId}, #{blogId}, #{commentId}, #{dislikeTime},
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.cover, b.views, b.likes, b.dislikes, b.collections, b.publish_time, b.create_time, u.id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar, c.name AS categoryName FROM dislike d JOIN blog b ON d.blog_id = b.id JOIN user u ON b.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY d.dislike_time DESC
